name: Redmond
note: The hospital in Redmond stopped delivering babies in 2019, so most Redmond families give birth in Bend or Madras. I meet you wherever you deliver, and postpartum, lactation and car seat visits all happen at your home in Redmond.
faqQuestion: Where do Redmond families give birth?
faqAnswer: St. Charles Redmond closed its Family Birthing Center in 2019. Most families deliver at St. Charles Bend, at a birth center, or at home. I support all of those.

serviceNotes.note: Redmond Fire & Rescue offers free car seat checks by appointment on set days. I offer a private session at your home in Redmond on a day that suits you, with as much time as you need to practice.
serviceNotes.faqQuestion: How is this different from the free car seat checks in Redmond?
serviceNotes.faqAnswer: Redmond Fire & Rescue holds free car seat check days by appointment, and they are a great resource. My sessions are private, at your home, on a day you choose, and built around teaching you to do it yourself.
